cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: paragraph · /ˈpærəˌɡræf/ · noun · Word · New
a group of sentences about one main idea. Write one paragraph about your home.
handwriting · /ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ/ · uncountable noun · Word · New
the way a person forms letters when writing by hand. Your handwriting is easy to read.
workbook · /ˈwɝkˌbʊk/ · noun · Word · New
a book with exercises for a student to complete. Open your workbook to page ten.
worksheet · /ˈwɝkˌʃit/ · noun · Word · New
a sheet of paper with tasks or questions for students. Write your name on the worksheet.
spell out · /ˌspɛl ˈaʊt/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to say or write every letter of a word in order. Please spell out your last name.
Recall and use
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.
